dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.debug.core.replaceLineDelimiterPref>
<!description: Replaced custom private method getLineDelimiterPreference with standard ResourcesPlugin.getLineSeparator (Eclipse 4.17 / Java 11+).>
<!severity: HINT>
getLineDelimiterPreference($file) :: sourceVersionGE(11) && instanceof($file, "org.eclipse.core.resources.IFile")
=> org.eclipse.core.resources.ResourcesPlugin.getLineSeparator($file)
;;
summary: Replace calls to a deprecated custom line delimiter preference method with the standard `ResourcesPlugin.getLineSeparator` API.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
